say: A machine copies your brain. Every atom. [0.6] Which one is you?
The copy wakes up with all your memories. [0.55] ~It is certain it is you.
But you are still standing right there. [0.6] ~Nothing changed.
Is consciousness just a pattern that can be duplicated? [0.8] ~Nobody knows. [0.6] It is one of the deepest open questions in science.
But physics has a surprise. [0.65] ~A perfect copy is impossible.
It is called the no-cloning theorem. Proven in the year nineteen eighty-two. [0.65] ~An unknown quantum state can never be copied exactly.
Nature allows one thing instead. Physicists have teleported the states of single particles. [0.7] ~But only by destroying the original.
So at the deepest level, no copy of you could ever be exact.
Whether your mind needs that level of detail is still a mystery. [0.75] For now, the universe keeps you one of a kind.
